roster.note: the first spacecraft to orbit Jupiter — eight years studying the giant planet and its major moons up close

roster.name: The atmospheric probe
roster.note: on arrival, Galileo released a probe that plunged into Jupiter's clouds — the first and only direct sample of a giant planet's atmosphere

roster.name: Europa's hidden ocean
roster.note: Galileo's magnetic and imaging data made the strongest case yet that an ocean of liquid water lies beneath the ice of Jupiter's moon Europa

roster.name: The stuck antenna
roster.note: the main antenna failed to open fully; the mission was rescued by new data-compression software beamed up to the spacecraft, salvaging most of the science over a trickle-speed link

roster.name: The deliberate end
roster.note: out of fuel, Galileo was flown into Jupiter on purpose, to be certain it could never crash onto Europa and contaminate its ocean

see_also.label: Cassini — the same idea, at Saturn

links.l: The ocean of Europa — Galileo's biggest legacy
